name: Alice Nakiri
desc: Alice Nakiri is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student, alumna, and the former 6th seat of the Elite Ten Council in the manga only. She is the daughter of Sōe Nakiri and Leonora Nakiri, the paternal cousin of Erina Nakiri, and one of the major characters of the series.

name: Yor Forger
desc: While she works as an ordinary office clerk at Berlint City Hall, she also leads a secret life as a Garden assassin under the code name "Thorn Princess"
